verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge is a shared knowledge store for agents, so emitting outbound webhook events on page changes is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The Slack/Monday item describes inbound source connectors, and agents picking up edits on their next turn is in-process propagation, not a webhook subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
